items.q: when you made those records with your friend Tommy Ludnier you know in about 1933

ctx.x: But he didn't do it deliberately, he had a, I guess that's just the way he thought it would be. But to me, we never knew when there was going, we taped every show every day. This is one that George picked out to make a record of.

Well, you know the very first, now when you made those records with your friend Tommy Ludnier you know in about 1933, it was the same thing, he was just sort of overriding the whole thing, it was the trombone......
